pages.text: Botanists speak of a time when mana was freely available from sunlight and moonlight. While many enjoyed free mana, it was deemed to be rather boring and discouraged use of more interesting generating flowers. A decision was made by higher ups that these "free mana" flowers would decay after some time. They were later banished entirely from Botany.
It appears that the timeline has been altered by the super nova. Now, all generating flowers decay after one hour $(italics)IRL time/$. $(br2) Looks like another challenge to automate.
